text: Hamza - housewarming Sat @ new flat in Leyton, from 7. bring wine not flowers, his gf Ioana hates lilies
Kate (boss) moving to the Dublin office in Jan. replacement not announced yet. ask Luca if he's going for it

dinner @ Nadia & Julien's Fri at 8 - their 10th anniv. remind me to pick up the cake the day before, they're doing a lemon thing so nothing citrus. Julien's parents coming over from Lyon for it too, staying the wk. Nadia slightly stressed abt hosting all of them, their flat's tiny. offer to bring extra chairs

Emeka - client call w/ the Petrov ppl moved to Thurs 2pm. he's v stressed, deck nowhere near done & his manager wants a dry run that morning. Hoang meant to be helping but he's off w/ flu. Emeka's also flying to Lagos the day after for his cousin's wedding so no slack at all. he's not eating properly either
Dorota's leaving drinks = cancelled. she's staying on til March now after all. Lukas still wants smth on the 28th instead?
Obi - mum had hip op Tues, went ok. he's off rest of wk, back in Mon. sounds shattered
Chloe - vegan now + no nuts. for xmas do menu
Niamh & Dafydd expecting!! due late May. she told me @ lunch. their eldest Caitlin starts reception in Sept, she's v excited abt being a big sister
dentist Weds 9:15, then gym. renew railcard b4 the 3rd
Jin's 40th - Sat 14th, curry place on Brick Ln, 7:30. he's been dropping hints abt a film camera. chip in w/ Asha?

Suzanne (HR) - restructure mtg tmrw @ 10. Kerry's role prob affected. Kerry v anxious, hasn't slept properly in a wk, kept asking me if I'd heard anything. I haven't. ask her how it went afterwards, maybe lunch the day after if it's bad news
Santiago - dog Pepe had op on his back leg, recovering. Santi WFH all wk to keep an eye on him

Farid & Shreya bbq Sun from 1pm. I'm doing the salads + bringing chairs. their son Luis turns 5 the wk after, dinosaur everything apparently. Shreya mentioned he's been struggling at nursery, biting another kid, and they've got a meeting w/ his key worker Tues morning. Farid's not worried, she is
Miriam - promoted to senior PM!! starts the new role 1st Nov. send congrats card
Tendai - interview @ Deloitte Mon 11am. nervous, first one in 6 yrs. text good luck Sun night, call him Mon eve to see how it went
Adriana Bianchi - new client, Milan based. prefers calls to email, hates being cc'd on everything. 2 kids, both at uni in London
Ivan - back from Sofia, his dad's funeral was last wk. quiet but ok. don't push him on the Q3 deadline
Hoang + Sophie engaged!! party @ hers sometime in Dec, date tbc
Rafael - his 2 girls have swimming gala Sat morning, then he's coming to Hamza's thing afterwards
Kerry - restructure mtg went fine, role safe. massively relieved
book table for 6 @ Dishoom Fri 8pm. confirm numbers by Weds lunchtime
Naledi - cat Biscuit missing since Sun. posters up round Walthamstow. she's in bits. msg her tonight

Luca - sister Caitlin's wedding in Tuscany 21 June. he's doing a reading, dreading it. whole family flying out the Thurs before. his mum Mrs Bianchi already panicking abt the seating plan. he asked if I'd read it through w/ him, maybe the wk before he goes
dinner w/ Julien Moreau (client) Tues at half 7 @ the Ivy. Jules bringing his partner. order cab for after
Asha - started pottery class Thurs eves. obsessed. wants her own wheel lol, bday's in Feb
Obi & his wife - housewarming pushed to 2nd Nov, kitchen still not finished
Shreya - 1:1 w/ new manager Fri at 3. worried abt her review, last one was rough. ask how it went
Emeka's pitch - WON the Petrov account!! team drinks Thurs after work

Hamza's dad 70th - surprise party Sat 22nd @ the golf club. Ioana says DON'T mention to H. arrive by 6:45, he's being walked in at 7. Hamza's brother doing a speech, Hamza too but he hates public speaking. Ioana wants a photo for the slideshow from the 2019 trip - dig one out and send it by Weds

chat w/ Dafydd after standup - Niamh's scan was Tues morning, all fine, it's a girl. Caitlin wants to call her Elsa. he's knackered tho, Caitlin not sleeping & he's covering Nadia's clients while she's off. need to sort cover rota w/ Suzanne by Fri, and take him for a pint next wk
Kate - her leaving do Thurs 5th @ the Crown from 6. collection going round
Jin - allergic to shellfish. teetotal since Jan too
Sophie Lewis (client, Leeds) - contract renewal call the 12th at half 9. wants new pricing beforehand. send deck the day before
Ivan & Dorota split up. Lisbon trip's off obvs. D moving back to Krakow in Dec
Chloe asked if I'm bringing a plus-one to xmas party. RSVP by end of wk
grocery run / collect parcel from PO before 5 / call bank re card
Naledi - Biscuit FOUND!! in a neighbour's shed lol
Lukas - new starter on my team, Mon. ex-Amazon, lives in Croydon, cycles in. show him round first thing
Miriam's husband Luis - knee surgery 3rd Dec. she's taking the wk after off to look after him
Farid - Berlin marathon Sun!! first one. pretty nervous, calf been playing up. text him that morning
Santiago's housewarming - Sat 9th, Peckham, from 4. his flatmate Hoang is DJing. bring the Rioja he likes
Tendai - didn't get Deloitte. gutted. KPMG 2nd round the wk after next tho
Adriana wants revised proposal by Weds EOD. her boss signs off Thurs morning

dinner party here Sat, 8 ppl. me: lamb. Nadia doing dessert, Julien bringing cheese. check w/ Jin re shellfish / booze. Chloe can't come, her sister's hen. Kerry bringing her new bf Ivan? first time meeting him. start 7:30, so marinate lamb the night before & clean bathroom that morning
Kerry's daughter graduating from Bristol 18th July. Kerry v proud, showed me pics of the halls
Rafael - Moreau & Co lost the tender. he's taking it hard, been on that account 12 yrs
Hoang - got into the Philharmonic choir!! first rehearsal next Tues eve
Mum's 65th - Sun 30th, lunch @ hers at 1. pick up cake that morning, card the day before

lunch w/ Shreya & Asha. Asha thinking of quitting to do pottery full time (?!). Shreya's mum visiting from Pune for 3 wks from Fri, she's taking a few days off the wk after. Asha's also moving flat on the 1st, out of Hackney finally, into a place with her sister Naledi. needs a van Sat morning - maybe lend her mine
Nadia - off sick, shingles. out til mid next wk. I'm covering her Kumar call tmrw at 10
Emeka + wife - 2nd baby arrived Sun night!! boy, 3.4kg. both doing well
Julien - bday drinks moved Fri -> Sat 8pm, same bar. Jules says no presents (again)
gym 7am tmrw then laundry. car insurance before the 15th

Obi called re Fri offsite. Kate wants everyone in Reading by 9, so leaving at 7. Obi driving, picking me up. dinner after the session, then a quiz Suzanne's running - she's nervous abt it apparently, first time hosting. Obi also asked if I can cover his Mon morning mtg w/ the Wang ppl since he's at his son's sports day. say yes, prep notes Sun
Dorota - 3 cats. vet bill for Mr Whiskers' teeth was £600
Caitlin Evans - starting @ Unilever 4th Nov, marketing. last day w/ us end of Oct. leaving lunch the Weds before
Luis - partner Sophie standing for council in May. he's v into it, canvassing every wkend
cousin Kate's wedding - 3rd Aug, Cardiff. hen do in Ibiza 2 wks before. flights ugh
Hamza - new puppy!! cockapoo called Bramble. pics on WhatsApp. Ioana not sleeping lol
Tendai - KPMG 2nd round tmrw 10am. remind me to send him Ivan's interview notes tonight. call him the evening after
